text:
maria: Quick follow-up from the S3 spike postmortem — pulling together the concrete test and ops items so we can close the loop. I split into three incident-driven additions: prompt/regression sets, realistic load scenarios, and a quarterly chaos drill. Need owners + timelines.

samir: thanks. can you paste the action list? want to make sure we don't duplicate existing tickets.

maria: sure — copied from notes: 
- ACTION-1: add a focused regression prompt set capturing the S3-failure prompts (prefixes, truncated responses, fallback triggers). owner: unassigned. scope: unit + integration evals. acceptance: new prompts catch the failure mode in CI.
- ACTION-2: create a load scenario that reproduces connection-fanout + KV-cache pressure we saw. includes 95th/99th token-latency targets. owner: unassigned. scope: dedicated test harness + k6 script.
- ACTION-3: model-fallback regression: simulate pod drain and verify automatic fallback to compatible model variant and no user-visible errors. owner: unassigned.
- ACTION-4: schedule quarterly chaos drill (2-hour window) to run the above scenarios with oncall and infra. owner: unassigned.
- ACTION-5: add alert correlation rule in pagerduty to mark repeated s3-related incidents as "recurring-pattern" for faster triage. owner: oncall team.

jordan: SGTM. I can take ACTION-4 (chaos drill) and run the first one next quarter. will add a short checklist for roles. ETA: planning doc by next Tue.

leo: I'll pick up ACTION-1 (prompt/regression sets). will extract the failing prompts from last night and add them to tests/regression/prompt_sets/s3_spike.yaml. will also add a small quality gate in CI that runs on every model rollover. ETA: end of week.

anya: I can own ACTION-2 (load scenario). I'll author a k6 script and add a nightly job in our staging cluster. quick note: we should parameterize the KV cache hit ratio to reproduce pressure.

maria: thanks all. assigning provisional JIRA refs so we have traceability: RWINF-987 (prompt sets), RWINF-988 (load scenario), RWINF-989 (fallback regression), RWINF-990 (chaos drill), RWINF-991 (alert correlation). I'll create epics and link to the postmortem.

ops-bot: Created epic RWINF-990: "incident-driven chaos drills" (link: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/RWINF-990)

samir: question on acceptance criteria for the prompt set — do we want to assert token-level divergence or human-eval thresholds?

maria: start with deterministic checks for the specific failure reproduction (e.g., truncated output, missing tool calls). add a small human-eval bucket for regression sensitivity. we can iterate.

leo: putting a quick test command here for reviewers:
```
# run only s3-spike prompt set locally
pytest tests/regression/test_prompt_sets.py::test_s3_spike_prompts -q
```

anya: load script sketch (k6):
```
import http from 'k6/http';
import { sleep } from 'k6';
export default function () {
  let r = http.post(__ENV.API_ENDPOINT + '/v1/generate', JSON.stringify({prompt: '...'}), { headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + __ENV.TOKEN } });
  sleep(Math.random() * 0.2);
}
```

jordan: added an item to the chaos drill checklist: "verify model fallback without request loss" and "monitor request tracing to ensure KV cache isn't leaking keys".

maria: small governance ask — let's make these incident-driven tests part of the regression suite that must be reviewed on each incident closure. want to avoid drifting. recommend a label `incident-regression` and a weekly audit.

samir: SGTM. can infra help with automated provisioning for the k6 staging job? need ephemeral GPUs for the full flow.

anya: yes, will coordinate with eng-infra. tagging @leo for any dev-only infra needs.

leo: noted. I'll add a lightweight docker-compose stub for local dev so folks can run the prompt tests without GPUs.

maria: timeline recap:
- RWINF-987 (prompt sets): leo, ETA Fri
- RWINF-988 (load scenario): anya, ETA next Wed
- RWINF-989 (fallback regression): samir + eng-runtime, ETA 2 weeks
- RWINF-990 (chaos drill planning): jordan, planning doc Tue, drill next quarter
- RWINF-991 (alert correlation): ops team, ETA Mon

samir: I'll pair with runtime team on RWINF-989 — adding a small canary that forces fallback in staging so we can assert zero user-visible errors.

oncall-bot: Reminder: oncall rotation check-in tomorrow 09:00 — please ensure triage owners are aware of the drill (reaction :bell: to acknowledge).

maria: please react with :thumbsup: when you've accepted ownership in JIRA. I'll do a follow-up sync next Thursday in the eng-sre weekly to confirm progress.

leo: accepted RWINF-987 :thumbsup:

anya: accepted RWINF-988 :thumbsup:

jordan: accepted RWINF-990 :thumbsup:

samir: putting myself on RWINF-989 TODOs now :thumbsup:

maria: great — closing the thread for now. I'll post the links to the epics once they're created and ping people individually for any blockers. cheers. :raised_hands:
